Test case: Search by clicking button returns results
Steps: 1. Type word in search box. 2. Click search button
Expected result: Products matching the word are shown

Test case: Search by pressing Enter returns same results as button
Steps: 1. Type word in search box. 2. Press Enter
Expected result: Same products as TC01 are shown

Test case: Search with no match shows empty state message
Steps: 1. Type a word that matches nothing. 2. Click search button
Expected result: Page says no products found and shows zero products

Test case: Clear button empties search and restores full list
Steps: 1. Click the clear button next to the search box
Expected result: Search box is empty and full product list is visible

Test case: Sort by price high to low shows most expensive first
Steps: 1. Open any category. 2. Select sort by price high to low
Expected result: First product has the highest price of all products shown

Test case: Sort by name Z to A shows products in reverse alphabetical order
Steps: 1. Open any category. 2. Select sort Z to A
Expected result: Products appear in reverse alphabetical order

Test case: Sorting inside a category filters to that category only
Steps: 1. Select sort by price high to low
Expected result: Only Power Tools products appear and page still shows category name

Test case: Typing a quantity in the product page field updates the cart
Steps: 1. Clear quantity field. 2. Type 3. 3. Click Add to cart. 4. Open cart
Expected result: Cart shows quantity 3 for that product

Test case: Changing quantity in cart updates line price and total
Steps: 1. Change quantity to 2. 2. Check line price and total
Expected result: Line price is 2x unit price and cart total updates accordingly

Test case: Cart icon count updates when cart quantity changes
Preconditions: Cart has one item with quantity 1

Test case: Eco product line price is correct even with discount on total
Steps: 1. Check unit price on product page. 2. Add to cart. 3. Check line price in cart
Expected result: Line price matches unit price; total may be lower due to eco discount

Test case: Removing only item shows empty cart message
Steps: 1. Click remove on the cart item
Expected result: Cart shows empty message and no products

Test case: Contact form requires all five fields before sending
Steps: 1. Leave all fields empty. 2. Click Send
Expected result: Form does not submit and shows validation errors

Test case: Empty fields show one error message each under that field
Steps: 1. Leave all fields empty. 2. Click Send
Expected result: Each empty field has exactly one error message beneath it

Test case: Partially filled form keeps entered values after validation
Steps: 1. Fill in first name only. 2. Click Send
Expected result: First name still shows John after the form shows errors

Test case: Out of stock product cannot be added to cart
Steps: 1. Open the product page. 2. Try to add to cart
Expected result: Add to cart button is disabled or absent; product is not added
